summary: Source-reviewed re-review completed for RiLK1: the database layer now verifies source-supported DBAASP/CAMP rows, preserves the DRAMP sequence conflict, and final adjudication accepts the paper with explicit cautions rather than hiding unsupported database categories.
adjudication_summary: Worker-4 and worker-6 re-review closed the full_source_review_not_completed ticket by reopening XML, PDF text, supplement text, figure locators, and linked database snapshots. The paper is publication-grade with cautions because recoverable source-supported values are recorded and non-exact database rows remain marked as conflicts.

materials_exhausted.note: Local XML/PDF/OA package, one PDF supplement text, figure captions/images, and packet-linked database snapshots were sufficient for obtainable-only adjudication; no missing external material is required for the remaining cautions.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP target-activity rows and literature rows were source verified; DRAMP sequence mismatch and non-exact cytotoxicity categories are preserved as source_conflict; CAMP terminal modification remains sequence_modified_not_normalized.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Final activity/toxicity rows use source-supported Table 5 bacterial values, section/Figure 7 antifungal outcomes, section/Figure 8/supplement morphology evidence, and BALB 3T3 viability values; unsupported database-only numeric cytotoxicity categories are not promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism is limited to indirect membrane-mimetic conformational context and phenotype-level antimicrobial activity; no direct molecular mechanism is overclaimed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_4_material_packet: Material packet remains distinct from final adjudication; local source assets were sufficient for obtainable-only review and no unrecoverable material gap blocks this paper.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DRAMP29087 is linked to this paper and its activity text is mostly source-supported, but the DRAMP sequence field does not match the primary RiLK1 sequence; it remains source_conflict, not source_verified.
DBAASP cytotoxicity rows encode a numeric 0% category; source-supported final toxicity rows use morphology/no-alteration and BALB 3T3 viability endpoints instead.
CAMP RiLK1 sequence/activity match local source, but C-terminal NH2 is not independently explicit for RiLK1 in the local primary text and is retained as sequence_modified_not_normalized.
CD/fluorescence support membrane-mimetic conformational context; no direct pore/permeabilization or molecular target assay is reported in local material.

strict_gate.acceptance_boundary: Accepted with cautions only because all remaining issues are preserved source conflicts or scope cautions, not blocking missing values.
